translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: ATimoti itah mai aPol mai aSilas
APol iyar van vǝbar naut a Terpe mai a Listra. Len naut a Listra ikad ahai susur sua nahǝsan aTimoti, anan evi Ju tokad nadǝlomian, be atǝman evi uleKris.
Alat lotokad nadǝlomian len naut a Listra mai a Ikonium luke gai evi vanuan tovoi.
APol ike aTimoti titah maii len nǝyaran san, ale esǝhari hǝn b̃etiv dalusi bathut naJu gail lotosuh len naut galenan, husur galit p̃isi lolǝboii ke atǝman evi uleKris.
Len nǝ-yar-tur-an salito len nab̃iltivile gail, lukel mai alatenan nǝ-kai-tasi-an hǝn lǝb̃igol husuri, nǝ-kai-tasi-an ahai pispisul gail mai alat lotoil a m̃o len naut a Jerusalem lotodam̃ hǝni.
Imagenan alat siYesu len naut gail ludaŋ am len nadǝlomian salito mai logǝm lusob̃ur am len nǝmariboŋ ṽisusua.
Len naut a Troas aPol eris na-kǝta-risi-an sua
Pol galito luyar tur len naut gail a Frijia mai a Kalatia husur aNunun aGot ekǝkol hǝn nap̃isal hǝn lǝb̃ikel ur nasoruan len naprovens Asia.
Nǝboŋ lotobar naut a Misia, lugol risi ke levi lan naprovens Pitinia be aNunun aYesu ip̃on gol galito.
Ŋa luyar tur naut gail a Misia, lovi pan vi Troas bitas.
Len mariug aPol eris na-kǝta-risi-an togǝm len nǝmav. Ikad auleMasetonia toil ŋiri ke, “Gegǝm vi Masetonia hǝn gǝb̃evi tarhǝt sinamito.”
Nǝboŋ toris na-kǝta-risi-an tonoŋ, vǝha-sua ŋai eutaut hǝn namtb̃evi Masetonia husur inau sǝhoti ke aGot ike namtikel ur na-kel-uri-an tovoi mai galit ei.
Nǝpairan van hǝn aGot seLitia
Nǝboŋ namttoriŋ naut a Troas, namtuwol inor vi lan naholoul Samotras. Pelan han namtuvahut len naut a Neap̃olis.
Namtoriŋ naut enan, namtuyar vi Filippi, alat a Rom lotoum hǝni vatoh lan. Evi nab̃iltivile sua toil a m̃o len naprovens Masetonia. Namtutoh ei len nǝmariboŋ galevis.
Len nǝSappat namtovivile metlǝkau hǝn navile tarhǝt hǝn nawisel. Namtunau ke ikad naut hǝn na-sor-tuṽ-an ei, ale namtobǝtah, namtusor mai alatpǝhaṽut lotob̃onb̃on ei.
Ikad apǝhaṽut sua, nahǝsan aLitia, tolotu hǝn aGot, tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn ginamito. Evi tob̃taTiatira top̃ur hǝn nǝkaliko toboŋboŋ. Nasub̃ eb̃ur nǝlon hǝn b̃esǝsǝloŋ husur nǝsa aPol tokele.
Nǝboŋ gai mai alat lototoh maii lotobaptais tonoŋ, eus ginamit ke, “Mǝtb̃isab̃ sǝhoti ke notodǝlom kitin len Nasub̃, mǝtegǝm hǝn mǝtb̃itoh len naim sagw.” Ale igol ke namtudam̃ hǝni.
APol mai aSilas len naim bǝbaŋis

Len nǝboŋ sua namtovi lan naut na-sor-tuṽ-an enan ale natǝbarehreh sua tovi slev, ebubur mai ginamito. Gai ikad natǝmat togol ke, ikel ur nǝsa b̃evisi. Imagenan alat lotokad naslev enan lulav nǝvat isob̃ur lan.
Alitenan ehusur aPol mai ginamito, ikaikai ke, “Lalum̃an galegai lovi slev siGot toyalyal buni. Lukel uri mai gamito nap̃isal hǝn nǝ-lav-kuvi-an dan nǝsaan samito.”
Ehisi imagenan len nǝboŋ tosob̃ur. Be igol nǝlon aPol ipaŋpaŋ, ipair van hǝni, ikel mai natǝmat ke, “Nukele idaŋ mai gaiug len nahǝsan aYesu Kristo, gimakuv dani.” Vǝha-sua ŋai imakuv.

Be nǝboŋ alat lotokad naslev enan lotolǝboii ke alitenan edǝdas b̃ilav nǝvat ideh am m̃os galito, lutah gat aPol mai aSilas, liv gargar gǝlaru vi lan nǝmaket hǝn lǝb̃eriŋ gǝlaru len nǝhon alat lotoil a m̃o len nab̃iltivile.
Nǝboŋ lotosǝhar gǝlaru van hǝn nab̃iltimatsistret gail, luke, “Alaruegai arugol nǝ-b̃al-taṽtaṽor-an len nab̃iltivile sidato. Arovi uleJutea,
ale arukel ur naṽide gail nalo sidat toke sanor hǝn datb̃idam̃ hǝni mai datb̃ehusuri, husur datovi uleRom gail.”
Naluṽoh am lomǝtahun gǝlaru ale nab̃iltimatsistret gail lukel mai nasoltia ke, litar sil nahurabat sǝlaru ale ṽas gǝlaru.
Nǝboŋ lotoṽas gǝlaru vǝha-sob̃ur, lubar hǝn gǝlar len naim bǝbaŋis. Ale lukele hǝn naulum̃an hǝn naim bǝbaŋis ke tekǝtkǝta kǝkol gat gǝlaru.
Igol nǝsa lotokele, eriŋ gǝlaru len narum̃ lohoim buni ale ibaŋis gat narielaru len nǝhai.
Tub̃loh len mariug aPol mai aSilas arusor tuṽ mai arokǝkai hǝn nǝb̃e gail van hǝn aGot, ale alat lotosuh len naim bǝbaŋis losǝsǝloŋ hǝn gǝlaru.
Losǝhoṽut, nadu todaŋ ekur hǝn nǝpaudesen hǝn naim bǝbaŋis. Vǝha-sua ŋai nabopita gail losǝŋav ale natsen salit p̃isi lumarub̃.
Nǝboŋ naulum̃an hǝn naim bǝbaŋis tolele, toris nabopita lotosǝŋav, eliv kuv nab̃iltib̃u san hǝn b̃isar bun gai gabag, husur inau ke alat lotosuh ei lugam yav tia.
Be aPol ikai habat ke, “Sagisar gaiug! Gidat p̃isi datosuh gegai.”
Naulum̃an enan eus nam̃ial, igam lohoim, ale ipab, etǝŋedur bathurien aPol mai aSilas.
Beti esǝhar gǝlaru vivile, eus gǝlar ke, “Nasub̃ gǝlaru, nigol nǝsa hǝn asike nǝb̃ipanis sil nǝsaan sagw?”
Arusor vari ke, “Gikad nadǝlomian len Nasub̃ aYesu ale dereh tilav kuv gaiug dan nǝsaan sam̃. Imagenan hǝn alat lotosuh len naim sam̃ am.”
Ale arukel nasoruan siNasub̃ mai atenan, mai alat lotosuh len naim san.
Len namityal enan len mariug, ekǝkas nahurhubelaru tomap̃ulp̃ul, beti gai mai nǝbathudud san lubaptais.
Esǝhar gǝlaru vi lohoim ale eriŋ nǝhanian a m̃o hǝn gǝlaru ale gai mai galit p̃isi lotosuh maii lukemkem masuṽ bathut nadǝlomian lotomadhakade len aGot.
Len naut tolan nǝmatsistret gail losǝvat alipah gail hǝn lǝb̃ike, “Sah rub̃at alaruenan arivan.”
Ale naulum̃an hǝn naim bǝbaŋis ikel mai aPol ke, “Nǝmatsistret gail lopisul ke nǝb̃erub̃at gamǝru. Imagenan mǝrolǝboi mǝrb̃eriŋ naut egai. Mirivan mǝdau.”

Avil aPol ikel mai alipah gail ke, “Lobilas ginamǝru len nǝhon nǝvanuan gail be lǝsakot hǝn ginamǝru. Naut kǝmas namrovi uleRom, lubar hǝn ginamǝru len naim bǝbaŋis. Galit lunau ke lesǝvat ginamǝru vi tut hǝn ke nǝvanuan gail asike lǝb̃elǝboii a? Aoa! Ivoi ke galit sǝb̃olit m̃au legǝm sǝhar kuv ginamǝru.”
Alipah gail lukel ur nasoruan enan mai nǝmatsistret gail. Lomǝtahw nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke gǝlaru artovi uleRom.
Ŋa luvan vaus gǝlaru ke saarinau gat nǝsa lotogol tosa hǝn gǝlaru. Beti losǝhar gǝlaru vivile ale lous gǝlaru hǝn arb̃eriŋ nab̃iltivile enan.
Nǝboŋ artoriŋ naim bǝbaŋis, arovi lan naim seLitia, ale nǝboŋ artoris nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail, arugol lolǝŋon ivoi am len nǝlolito, beti aruvan.

footnotes.text: 16.24 Nǝhai enan ikad nahudhut eru tokad naintses tarhǝte, nalok tarhǝte, mai ikad nab̃ur gail lan, narien nǝvanuan tosiriv len gail.
